picks.name: Vakula
picks.source_note: Oath already seeded. Two near-miss leads dropped along the way: a Batu EP on Oath sub-label Lethal Press turned out to be 2025 material misdated as 2026, and Idle Hands/Timedance both came up dry. Exact Bandcamp release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link uses the label's already-confirmed Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "Times" (May 8, 2026, Oath) is a four-track, hardware-led EP from Ukrainian producer Vakula -- preceded by two advance singles, "Atmos Time" and "Soul Time."
picks.why_listen: Deep, patient hardware-jam house from a long-running, idiosyncratic producer -- useful for a hypnotic, less-is-more stretch of a set.
